# Christopher Vistal

> Software engineer in the Philippines (UTC+8). I build production systems for government, law, and enterprise — case management, citizen records, and AI-powered tools that ship and stay shipped. Core stack: PHP/Laravel, Vue.js, Go, MySQL and AWS. 5+ years. Open to full-time remote roles and contracts.

## Summary

- Title: Software Engineer
- Experience: 5+ years in production software
- Location: Tandag, Surigao del Sur, Philippines (UTC+8); available for remote work
- Availability: open to full-time remote roles and contracts
- Contact: vistalchris@gmail.com
- Core stack: PHP, Laravel, Vue.js, Inertia.js, Go, MySQL, SQL Server, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, SES), Nginx, Docker

## Experience

### Freelance Software Engineer (2024 – Present)

Case management platform for a law firm (Laravel, Vue.js, Inertia.js, MySQL, AWS):
- Designed and shipped the platform solo in about 4 months; up to 10 attorneys and staff use it daily with role-based access control, and the firm's spreadsheet workflow is retired.
- Built billing, document automation from versioned templates, and email notifications via AWS SES.
- Added a client portal with attorney messaging and an audit trail of every view, edit and download.

University Data Hub for North Eastern Mindanao State University (Laravel, Go, Vue.js, MySQL, S3, ClamAV, ONLYOFFICE), live at https://udh.nemsu.edu.ph/:
- Built a Google Drive-style file and submissions platform with ONLYOFFICE for in-browser document collaboration, live for faculty across all 4 campuses.
- Wrote Go sidecars for resumable tus uploads that survive exam-week traffic on unreliable campus networks, ClamAV virus scanning with quarantine, and X.509 PDF signing.

### Software Engineer, Province of Surigao del Sur (2021 – 2024)

Laravel, Vue.js, MySQL, SQL Server, Python, Android:
- Built a records platform for 500+ civil-servant files (https://epds.surigaodelsur.gov.ph/) and a tourism analytics dashboard (https://ars.surigaodelsur.gov.ph/), replacing paper and Excel.
- Cut reporting response times by ~60% by fixing N+1 queries and adding indexes.
- Built an offline AI speech-to-text tool (Python, Whisper, CTranslate2) for the Office of the Secretary to the Sangguniang Panlalawigan (provincial board), so confidential audio never leaves the machine.
- Automated payroll deductions, tax reporting and SMS alerts, and built a Java Android employee app and a self-hosted uptime monitor, turning half-day tasks into one click.
- Introduced Git, code review and CI/CD to the team; mentored 3 engineers.

### Intern Developer, North Eastern Mindanao State University (Jul – Aug 2018)

- Built a faculty evaluation web app where students rate their instructors' teaching; used by 3,000+ students.
- Added Python sentiment analysis on written feedback, giving administrators data for strategic planning and decision-making.

## Personal projects

- Chriscast (https://github.com/christophervistal25/christcast): Raycast-style file launcher for Linux; indexes 200K+ files in ~5s with sub-millisecond search (Go, GTK3, fsnotify).
- Repository Cleaner (https://github.com/christophervistal25/repository-cleaner): terminal GitHub manager to search, multi-select and bulk-delete repositories with vim-style keys (Go, Bubbletea, GitHub API).

## Skills

- Languages: PHP, Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL. Java appears on the provincial Android employee app, not as a primary language.
- Frameworks: Laravel, Vue.js, Inertia.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js / Express, REST APIs, PHPUnit, Pest
- Data: MySQL, SQL Server, S3, queues
- Infrastructure: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, SES), Docker, Nginx, Cloudflare, ClamAV, Linux, CI/CD, RBAC
- AI / ML: Whisper, CTranslate2, on-device inference, NLP

## Education
